## Public API the screen packages consume

- `Wakeel.Core.Services.Correspondence`: `ITemplateService` (GetAsync / CheckAsync / PrepareLocalCopyAsync / SaveLocalCopyAsync / RemoveLocalCopyAsync / LocalCopyPath), `ILetterComposer` (Compose → docx, RenderHtml → preview/PrintToPdf), `ILetterTemplateInspector`, `IWordAutomation` (EditAsync, EditFileAsync), `ILetterPdfWriter`, `ILetterDocumentStore` (B3-2 implements it over the vault), `IBuiltInLetterTemplate`; models `LetterData`, `LetterBody`/`LetterBlock`/`LetterSpan` (+ `LetterBody.Parse`), `LetterPageSize`, `LetterMarks`, `LetterTemplateCheck`, `LetterTemplateSource`, `LetterAr`.
- `Wakeel.Reports.Letters`: `LetterComposer`, `LetterTemplateInspector`, `BuiltInLetterTemplate`, `DerivedDocumentBuilder` (implements Core's `IDerivedDocumentBuilder`), `LetterDates`, `LetterHtmlRenderer`, `LetterPageLayout`, `WordSession`.

## Review round 1 — findings applied (2026-09-17)

- [x] Finding 2 + supervisor ruling (1): `CoreAr` is now `public static partial class`; the letter strings moved to `src/Wakeel.Core/Services/Correspondence/CoreAr.Letter.cs` as `CoreAr.Letter`; `LetterAr.cs` deleted and every caller updated. `ReferralTo`/`ReferralDue`/`PageSize` now isolate their values with `CoreAr.Isolate`.
- [x] Finding 1 (high) + 3: `LetterPdfWriter` no longer touches the window's engine. It creates its own `CoreWebView2Environment` under `<root>\staging\print` on a hidden never-shown window, prints, and disposes. `ILetterPdfWriter.ToPdfAsync` gained `LetterPageSize`; `LetterPageLayout.SizeInInches` (tested) feeds `CreatePrintSettings()` — page size, zero margins, backgrounds on.
- [x] Finding 4 + missing spec item (3): `WordSession.Run` sets `AutomationSecurity = 3` before `Documents.Open`; `TemplateService.IsPlainLetterPackage` refuses a package with `vbaProject.bin`/`vbaData.xml`, a main part that is not `...wordprocessingml.document.main+xml`, or any external relationship other than a hyperlink. `SaveLocalCopyAsync` now runs the check and returns it, writing nothing when it fails.
- [x] Finding 5: `LetterOpenXml.MergeRuns` walks `ChildElements`; a hyperlink/field/SDT between two runs breaks the merge, invisible markers do not.
- [x] Finding 6: `LetterHtmlRenderer.FillHtml` isolates each substituted value, leaving the template's own words outside the `<bdi>`; the test asserts `<bdi>و/م/1448/214</bdi>`.
- [x] Finding 7: a list item is `JustificationValues.Start`, asserted in `Compose_writes_paragraphs_lists_and_bold`.
- [x] Finding 8: `ReanchorVmlStyle(style, left, top)` shifts `left`/`top`/`margin-left`/`margin-top` by the margin in the unit they were written in, synthesises the distance when there is none, and leaves an unreadable one anchored to the page.
- [x] Finding 9: the body is inserted once per paragraph, and only into paragraphs that carried the mark BEFORE the letter's data was substituted; `LetterBodyWriter.Insert` returns its last paragraph.
- [x] Finding 10: the bullet level text is `\uF0B7` with the Symbol font, and the two abstract definitions are inserted after the last `w:numPicBullet`.
- [x] Finding 11: `WordFactAttribute`/`NoWordFactAttribute` (tests/Wakeel.Core.Tests/Letters/WordFacts.cs) skip with the reason in the run summary instead of passing silently.

## Review round 2 — findings applied (2026-09-17)

- [x] Finding 1 (high) + the missing spec item: the renderer no longer reuses the composer's walk. New `src/Wakeel.Reports/Letters/LetterLayoutReader.cs` reads the template as a sheet — it skips anything under `mc:Fallback` (each text box read once), puts the header parts' lines first and the footer parts' last, reads a text box where the paragraph that anchors it stands, and works out from `wp:anchor` (or, for a VML-only template, the shape's style) whether a box is a left block, a right block or a full-width band. Core gained `LetterTemplatePlace`, `LetterTemplateAlign`, `LetterTemplateLine` and `ILetterTemplateInspector.ReadLayout`; `LetterOpenXml.Paragraphs`/`TextOf` are untouched, so Compose and Check behave exactly as before. `LetterHtmlRenderer` now emits `<header class="letterhead">`, `<aside class="block left|right|band">` floats, a `<footer class="sheet-foot">`, and collapses a run of the template's blank paragraphs to one `<p class="blank">`. Against the reference template the printed sheet carries the letterhead, the date block, the subject and the signature once each, in the template's places.
- [x] Finding 2 (medium): `TemplateService.ReadLocalCopy` and `ReadSetupCopyAsync` now run `IsPlainLetterPackage` as well, so a local copy the office turned into something else while editing it in Word is not the template in force — `GetAsync` falls through to the next source.
- [x] Finding 3 (low): `LetterOpenXml.ReadableTextOf` maps `w:br` to a newline and `w:tab` to a space; the renderer prints one `<p class="line">` per segment, so the two dates in the template's date box are on lines of their own.
- [x] Finding 4 (low): `LetterComposer.Fill` splices out every body mark the insert did not use, and `LetterHtmlRenderer.AppendBody` strips the mark from the prefix and the suffix.
- [x] Tests added (9): TemplateServiceTests ×2 (a tampered local copy and a tampered setup copy both fall through to BuiltIn), LetterComposerTests ×1 (a line with the mark twice leaves no `@`), LetterHtmlRendererTests ×6 (each value printed once, the letterhead above the letter, the floating blocks, the line break in the date block, the padding collapsed, the double mark).
- [x] Full package command green: Reports, Core, tests (593 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped — the no-Word fact), Desktop.
